text: That the backoff procedure has been introduced in our system in order to avoid collisions between contending nodes. Our contending nodes in these examples are B and C, right? They are contending for the channel, and the backoff procedure is there to avoid the collision between them. So again, remember that we said Wi-Fi is a CSMA scheme with collision avoidance, right? This backoff is a mechanism that helps to avoid collisions. So the basic principle, the basic idea is very simple. Whenever there is a crowded situation, right, you try to disynchronize from the others so that you find a free route ahead, and this is exactly the same thing. So if there is peak hour, you don't want to jump into the traffic, right? As for the others, you try to pick, you wait, you try to pick a time at which not many other people will be there, and this is exactly the same principle. You try to pick a time in order to disynchronize your action with respect to the others, and this way.
